controlPurchase.heroTitle: Your overseas purchases secured, from the supplier to your door
controlPurchase.heroSubtitle: We find suppliers, negotiate prices, inspect quality and quantities, then ship your goods to Cameroon. You place the order, we verify everything on site.
controlPurchase.ctaContext: Hello MOLIÈRE CONSULTING, I'm interested in your Purchase Control service. Desired product: ..., quantity: ..., destination: ...
controlPurchase.introTitle: Buy from far away without getting scammed
controlPurchase.introP1: Ordering goods abroad from Cameroon remains risky: suppliers who go silent after payment, beautiful samples but disappointing production, missing quantities, inflated prices or parcels that never arrive.
controlPurchase.introP2b: service, our team becomes your eyes and hands on the ground. From supplier research to shipping to your city, every step is verified, documented and treated as if it were our own money.
controlPurchase.quoteSubtitle: Send us the product, the desired quantity and your destination: we reply with options and costs, with no obligation.
controlPurchase.risksTitle: Buying remotely comes with far too many bad surprises
controlPurchase.risk1Desc: Products different from the sample: wrong material, sloppy finishing, defective devices. Impossible to check from Douala or Yaoundé.
controlPurchase.risk2Desc: Missing parcels, fewer units, wrong references or sizes: without counting at departure, the loss is only discovered on arrival.
controlPurchase.risk3Desc: Without a local presence and comparisons, buyers often pay 20–50% too much, or deal with a supplier who disappears after the transfer.
controlPurchase.servicesTitle: Full purchasing support, from sourcing to delivery
controlPurchase.s1Desc: You describe the product, we identify reliable suppliers, compare offers and guide you to the best value for money.
controlPurchase.s2Desc: Our team negotiates prices, payment terms and lead times on your behalf: you get wholesale prices without losing your margin.
controlPurchase.s3Desc: Before anything ships, we inspect the goods: compliance with the sample, material, functioning, finishing and packaging. You approve based on evidence.
controlPurchase.s4Desc: We count units, parcels and references, and check dimensions and sizes, so the order received is exactly the order paid for.
controlPurchase.s5Desc: By sea or air, we arrange transport to Cameroon and track the parcel until delivery, in coordination with Molière Cargo.
controlPurchase.checkTitle: No goods leave without being verified
controlPurchase.checkP: Every order goes through a physical inspection before packing. You receive a clear report and give your approval: until you confirm, nothing is shipped.
controlPurchase.check1: Real photos and videos of your goods before departure
controlPurchase.check2: Verification of references, dimensions, colours and finishing
controlPurchase.check3: Exact counting of ordered parcels and units
controlPurchase.step1Desc: On WhatsApp, you share the product, quantity, budget and your city. We assess feasibility.
controlPurchase.step2Desc: We compare several suppliers and present the options with prices, photos and lead times.
controlPurchase.step3Desc: We negotiate terms and place the order only after your approval and a controlled payment.
controlPurchase.step4Desc: Physical inspection, counting, photos and videos: you approve the goods before they leave.
controlPurchase.step5Desc: We arrange sea or air freight and send you the parcel tracking.
controlPurchase.step6Desc: Your goods arrive in Cameroon; we remain available until complete handover.
controlPurchase.whyTitle: Why entrust us with your purchases
controlPurchase.w1Desc: Photos and videos of your products before shipping: you decide with full knowledge of the facts.
controlPurchase.w2Desc: Payments to suppliers are supervised step by step, with no blind transfer.
controlPurchase.w3Desc: A single MOLIÈRE advisor follows you on WhatsApp from brief to delivery, with fast replies.
controlPurchase.w4Desc: Purchase price, service fees and shipping costs communicated clearly, with no hidden charges.
controlPurchase.faqSubtitle: How the Purchase Control service works, clearly explained.
controlPurchase.faq1Q: What kinds of products can you inspect?
controlPurchase.faq1A: Most imported goods: textiles and footwear, electronics and accessories, professional equipment, household items, cosmetics, etc. Prohibited or regulated products are excluded: we confirm this when reviewing your request.
controlPurchase.faq2Q: Do I need to already know a supplier?
controlPurchase.faq2A: No. If you have a supplier, we verify them and deal with them. If not, we find one for you from reliable sources.
controlPurchase.faq3A: Our fees depend on the product type, the quantity and the level of inspection required. You receive a clear breakdown before any commitment: purchase price, service fee and shipping listed separately.
controlPurchase.faq4Q: What happens if the goods are non-compliant?
controlPurchase.faq4A: Since the inspection happens before shipping, we hold the order and negotiate correction, replacement or a refund voucher with the supplier. You only approve departure once everything is compliant.
controlPurchase.finalSubtitle: Send us your product and quantity on WhatsApp: a Purchase Control advisor replies with a clear proposal.

about.title: About MOLIÈRE CONSULTING
about.subtitle: A young, dynamic Cameroonian company driven by one belief: a job well done changes lives.
about.v1Desc: We treat every project as our own — seriously and enthusiastically.
about.v2Desc: Prices, timelines, conditions: you always know where you're going and why.
about.v3Desc: Douala and Yaoundé, plus a WhatsApp that really answers.
about.storyBody1: Founded in 2023, MOLIÈRE CONSULTING was born from a simple observation: too many dreams stall for lack of reliable support. A student eligible for a scholarship who doesn't know how to build the application, a businesswoman who wants to import from China without knowing whom to trust, an entrepreneur whose talent stays invisible online.
about.storyBody2: So we brought three areas of expertise together under one roof — travel to China and Canada, freight between Asia and Cameroon, and digital communication. Young, rigorous and passionate, we handle every file with the same drive: work done well, measurable results and a lasting relationship of trust.
